casual.label: Casual
casual.description: Everyday English; excludes names, pronouns, abbreviations and very rare words. Proper names and pronouns are excluded in every profile.

standard.label: Standard
standard.description: Phrase Forge beta default; broad English vocabulary with gameplay exclusions. Proper names and pronouns are excluded in every profile.

expert.label: Expert
expert.description: Allows rarer English vocabulary while retaining gameplay exclusions. Proper names and pronouns are excluded in every profile.

teacher.label: Teacher
teacher.description: Expert vocabulary plus educational metadata when available. Proper names and pronouns are excluded in every profile.
